searchText: The thing is totally reproducible, basically it synch's for ca 5 minutes, after which it logs as follows. After the 5 minutes it logs "Synchronization terminated". I can't see any logs of interest just all kinds of peers connected / rejected. But eth.synching just says false. The last non-false eth.synching output that I got was eth.syncing { currentBlock: 107029, healedBytecodeBytes: 0, healedBytecodes: 0, healedTrienodeBytes: 0, healedTrienodes: 0, healingBytecode: 0, healingTrienodes: 0, highestBlock: 109528, startingBlock: 0, syncedAccountBytes: 0, syncedAccounts: 0, syncedBytecodeBytes: 0, syncedBytecodes: 0, syncedStorage: 0, syncedStorageBytes: 0 } Note -- DEBUG[01-01|17:10:17.488] Synchronisation terminated elapsed=5m21.836s Command I ran : ./build/bin/geth --cache 4096 --syncmode=full --http --datadir /tmp/eth-test/ --metrics --metrics.expensive --pprof --networkid=1337702 --catalyst --http.api="engine,eth,web3,net,debug" --http.corsdomain "*" --http.addr "0.0.0.0" --verbosity 4 As far as I can tell, it never resumes synchronizing (message.txt has quite a lot more logs / expand) Can't seem to get besu to peer. With geth I use `--nat:extip` to advertise the correct IP. It appears that `--p2p-host` in besu should accomplish the same thing. Here's my full command line: `./besu --data-path "/home/seamonkey/eth/kintsugi-lighthouse-besu" --genesis-file "/home/seamonkey/eth/kintsugi-lighthouse-besu/besu_genesis.json" --rpc-http-apis="ETH, NET, WEB3, DEBUG" --rpc-http-cors-origins="moz-extension://a0ffd254-28a5-4292-bf02-4195ced390d3,moz-extension://f6780ea6-1162-4fe5-b170-c37b605ae299" --network-id=1337702 --sync-mode=full --p2p-port 13453 --rpc-http-port 8548 --p2p-host "1.2.3.4" --rpc-http-enabled` Also, I tried running with `--Xmerge-support=true`, but that yields `Unable to start mining without a coinbase`. Something else I need to add/change?

Can't seem to get besu to peer.  With geth I use `--nat:extip` to advertise the correct IP.  It appears that `--p2p-host` in besu should accomplish the same thing.  Here's my full command line:
`./besu --data-path "/home/seamonkey/eth/kintsugi-lighthouse-besu" --genesis-file "/home/seamonkey/eth/kintsugi-lighthouse-besu/besu_genesis.json" --rpc-http-apis="ETH, NET, WEB3, DEBUG" --rpc-http-cors-origins="moz-extension://a0ffd254-28a5-4292-bf02-4195ced390d3,moz-extension://f6780ea6-1162-4fe5-b170-c37b605ae299" --network-id=1337702 --sync-mode=full --p2p-port 13453 --rpc-http-port 8548 --p2p-host "1.2.3.4" --rpc-http-enabled`
Also, I tried running with `--Xmerge-support=true`, but that yields `Unable to start mining without a coinbase`.  Something else I need to add/change?
